# Why the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick order parameter has no gaps

> One theorem from OpenAI's mathematics release, family 281: every minimiser of the zero-temperature Parisi functional for the pure zero-field Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model has full support on [0,1). The site holds OpenAI's Lean beside three written accounts, and one graph of 131 steps joins them. The data calls a step a record.

Each paper is a narrower part of the same graph. Papers and records are drafts; no independent mathematical review has been done. Ties between the papers and the Lean are pointers written by AI agents after reading both sides. No independent mathematician has reviewed them, and a program confirms only that both ends of each one still exist.

Lean v4.34.1 compiled OAI.Probability.SKSupport.Main (`lake build OAI.Probability.SKSupport.Main`, exit 0) at OpenAI revision adc7f12, recorded 26 October 2026. Lean's extraction lists these axioms for OAI.ZeroTemperatureSK.full_support: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. The theorem assumes a minimiser. Comparator, a program that compares a Lean proof with a separately written statement, has accepted neither main statement, and the scalar value result has no successful build on record.

## Read

- [Exposition](https://wcook04.github.io/lean-exposition-site/pdf/exposition.pdf): objects and ideas, from a calculation with two spins
- [Short paper](https://wcook04.github.io/lean-exposition-site/pdf/short-paper.pdf): the result and proof for specialists
- [Long record](https://wcook04.github.io/lean-exposition-site/pdf/long-record.pdf): each step with its source, continuing to the QAOA circuits
- [Architectural companion](https://wcook04.github.io/lean-exposition-site/pdf/architecture.pdf): why the papers share one graph

## Data

All data is static JSON under https://wcook04.github.io/lean-exposition-site/edition/. Start at edition/index.json: it maps API routes to files, and `route_maps` holds further maps for per-module and per-record routes.

- The route "/alignment": for each record, its short title, Lean declarations with relation and exact `lines`, and exact statement slices in each paper, each slice with the Lean it means; a dictionary from Lean names to the papers' notation; `names`, plain titles for 511 declarations
- The routes "/ties/short", "/ties/long" and "/ties/expository": non-overlapping byte ranges of each paper, each with its ties to records and Lean lines (1,002 marked statements, 799 with Lean, in 1,152 ties). A tie is a pointer. No program tests whether the two texts mean the same thing.
- The reference tables behind the papers' links to theorems, equations, sections, figures and citations (792 links), in examples/qaoa-sk/alignment/references-*.json in the repository
- The routes "/lean/modules", "/lean/names" and "/lean/module": the Lean index (349 modules, 3,458 declarations at v4.34.1), one file per module with source, declarations and name references. Dependencies come from the source text and are not elaborated.
- The route "/graph" in edition/index.json: the whole recorded graph, with typed edges running from consumer to prerequisite

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/wcook04/lean-exposition): papers, records, tools and this website
- [Web API](https://github.com/wcook04/lean-exposition/blob/main/docs/web-api.md): routes and field meanings
